about: Freeze 2 of demo/blackout: the rules study asked again with a words list, where freeze 1 (FROZEN.json, unchanged) asked the kernel alone. Committed alone, after freeze 1's scored run and after a dry run of the new arm, before any question was asked with the words list. Held by test_blackout.py; a change is a new freeze.
known_when_frozen: freeze 1's scored run: scene R1 to R7 all passed; rules study S1 failed (1 of 12 worker's questions served a passage from the right file holding its words; the one that did, W9, uses the rules' own word, promptly), S2 failed (4 of 6 off-topic questions were served something: O1 to O4, on words like insider trading, item, form and earnings), S3 passed (0 of 6 nonsense). Eleven of twelve worker's questions were served nothing: no passage held half their content words, because a worker says sell and shares where the rules say sale and security. The words list was written after reading that, and was then checked against the kernel's format by a dry run of the new arm; no question was asked with it.

pass_rules.S1: at least 8 of the 12 worker's questions are served, among their first three passages, one from the right file that holds its words
pass_rules.S2: at most 2 of the 6 questions no rule answers are served anything
pass_rules.S3: none of the 6 nonsense questions is served anything
pass_rules.unchanged: the three rules and their thresholds are freeze 1's; their rows for this arm are named blackout-rules2:S1 to S3
